statement: For the ordinary 4 by 4 transversal achievement game exactly as frozen in source.md and formalized in problem.md, the minimax forced-win time is T_4=11. In particular, the exported positional O policy prevents X from completing a transversal through ply 9 against every legal X branch, while the recorded source strategy gives T_4 at most 11.
contribution: An exact unsymmetrized AND-OR computation exports a replayable 6,861-choice O defense DAG. A separately implemented verifier reconstructs all 24 transversals and exhaustively checks every legal X successor in the reachable graph, supplying the previously missing universal fixed-board lower bound. The full-resolution and novelty claims remain subject to fresh referee review.
